info.title: Rosetta implemented Foundation API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for implemented Core routes only, derived from source at the application-isolation milestone. Capability Registry, Resolver, Composition, delegation and provider dispatch remain separate design drafts. Reader/writer roles are not OAuth scopes. Tenant/app IDs in caller headers or JSON never supply authority. V2 is backend-only: bind an active registered app to verified tenant/issuer/client_id and operator-enrolled service-account subject. Layer-2 backends enforce human/domain decisions; no on-behalf-of delegation exists. Owner writes and exact expiring read shares are enforced at SQL/storage boundaries. App/owner suspension blocks subsequent v2 access, not already-authorized in-flight work. Workflow and explicitly allowlisted v1 resources remain tenant-scoped. See RESOURCE_AUTHORIZATION.md for migration, logical deletion and retained bytes.

servers.description: Local Compose only; substitute configured PUBLIC_URL. No public deployment is implied.

x-rosetta-upstream-boundary: /identity/ is a Keycloak passthrough. Only the documented protocol integration is standardized here; upstream admin/login-action/other protocol surfaces remain governed by the pinned provider, not advertised as Rosetta-owned APIs.
x-rosetta-routing-errors: Unsupported methods are normally 405 on health, identity, data, objects, administration and existing workflow instance paths. /ready, workflow definition/execution collections and resource-share routes return 404 for unsupported methods. Authentication, writer checks or resource lookup may reject first. Invalid app/record/object paths can return 400. HEAD always has no wire body. Unknown public routes return 404; Gateway /v1,/v2 auth precedes lookup. Gateway auth errors may be HTML.

post.description: Owner backend explicitly approves read of one live resource for a different active same-tenant app. No update/delete, resharing, wildcard or cross-tenant grant. Future object versions remain shared until expiry/revocation. Not a capability grant or human delegation.

delete.description: Owning backend only. Repeat revocation returns 204; hidden IDs return 404. Unsupported methods return 404. Audit and revocation are atomic.

post.description: Live operator-enrolled human principal, exact issuer/subject/management-client/tenant binding. Baseline core-reader suffices; core-writer is not administrative authority. Core errors include requestId; Gateway auth errors may be HTML or JSON without requestId. Exact owner/client/origin enrollment required; duplicate client binding conflicts even after revocation. No POST retry guarantee.

V2 access follows app state; clients are not disabled in Keycloak automatically. Legacy allowance is a separate permission.

get.description: Workflow resources remain TENANT scoped, not app-private. App suspension is not a workflow permission check. Keep private payloads out of tenant-visible variables. Up to 100 latest operator-installed definitions; no public deployment, cursor or offset.

post.description: Workflow resources remain TENANT scoped, not app-private. App suspension is not a workflow permission check. Keep private payloads out of tenant-visible variables. UUID key reserves tenant/definition/canonical input. Identical replay returns 200, changed input 409. Uncertain start reconciles history or remains pending; never blindly starts again. Not exactly-once external effects. JSON wire limit 64 KiB and input depth at most 32.

get.description: Workflow resources remain TENANT scoped, not app-private. App suspension is not a workflow permission check. Keep private payloads out of tenant-visible variables. State from durable engine history.

delete.description: Workflow resources remain TENANT scoped, not app-private. App suspension is not a workflow permission check. Keep private payloads out of tenant-visible variables. Repeated cancellation returns 204; completed execution returns 409. No rollback of external effects is implied.

IdempotencyKey.description: Tenant-scoped workflow key; identical definition/input returns existing execution, changed logical input conflicts.

NoSniff.description: Current Gateway may append its nosniff value to the Core value; duplicate header values are preserved.

ETag.description: Opaque strong revision tag. Send the exact value in If-Match; never construct it.

ContentLength.description: Byte length of the representation; HEAD sends no body.

providerOrigin.description: Canonical HTTPS origin with dotted DNS hostname, no IP literal, credentials, path, trailing slash or noncanonical casing. Exact operator enrollment required; schema syntax alone does not prove control.

expiresAt.description: Real UTC calendar instant, future and at most ten minutes away. Requester, resource, digest and revision must match the stored app.
Real UTC calendar instant, future and at most 24 hours away.

OidcTokenRequest.description: Provider-owned OAuth form. Client credentials require confidential-client authentication. Browser PKCE exchange has no client secret. Grant availability and required fields depend on enrolled Keycloak client policy.

OidcLogout.description: Provider form; local public PKCE fixture uses client_id and refresh_token. Client authentication follows upstream policy.
